name: net-ball
effect: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon is Water- or Bug-type, this ball has a catch rate of 3×. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3× for water and bug Pokémon.

flavor_text.diamond-pearl: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.
flavor_text.platinum: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.
flavor_text.heartgold-soulsilver: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on Water- and Bug-type Pokémon.
